meta.title: Identity Theft Protection Services Can't Actually Stop Identity Theft
meta.hook: Identity-theft monitoring cannot stop your personal information from being stolen. It can only warn you when misuse appears.
meta.description: Paid identity theft protection services mostly sell monitoring — watching your credit reports and accounts for signs of misuse — which detects fraud after it happens rather than preventing it. A credit freeze, which is free by federal law, blocks new accounts from being opened using your credit report in the first place. Educational content only, not financial advice.

scenes.narration: Identity-theft monitoring cannot stop your personal information from being stolen. It can only warn you when misuse appears.

visual.visual_intent: A laptop screen showing a security alert notification, dim room, cool blue light

scenes.narration: Monitoring services watch credit files or accounts for changes such as new inquiries, accounts, or exposed credentials.

visual.query: person checking phone banking app notification
visual.visual_intent: A hand holding a phone showing an account alert, home setting, natural light

scenes.narration: Those alerts can shorten response time, but they usually arrive after data was exposed or someone attempted a transaction.

visual.visual_intent: A clock face with hands moving, implying the time lag between event and detection
visual.decision_reason: the core distinction of the video

scenes.narration: A credit freeze does a different job: it restricts access to your credit file, making many new-account approvals harder.

visual.query: hooded figure computer dark room silhouette
visual.visual_intent: A silhouetted figure at a computer in a dim room, tense documentary tone
visual.decision_reason: illustrates the threat the monitoring can't preempt

scenes.narration: Federal law makes freezes free to place and lift with each nationwide credit bureau.

visual.visual_intent: A padlock graphic over a document representing a locked credit file, clean cinematic render
visual.decision_reason: 2018 Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act made credit freezes free nationwide (FTC)

scenes.narration: Monitoring is an alarm. A freeze is a lock on one door. Neither covers every kind of identity fraud, but they are not interchangeable.
